description: Rigify human metarig (generated rig, DEF- deform bones). First supported profile.
discarded: Rigify constraint-driven twist distribution (DEF-*.001 twist bones are kept as deform bones but follow their role bone rigidly in the engine, which evaluates no constraints)
Non-deform control/mechanism bones (ORG-, MCH-, controls): the engine animates deform bones directly
Bone roll / rest orientation: engine rest frames are axis aligned at each bone pivot (skinning is unaffected; authored local rotations are in engine axes)
